cars.route_validation: Staggered garage position; front-door use and walking routes checked separately from outside drive tracking.

limitations: Generic compact-car geometric check; not surveyed vehicle tracking. Tree relocation feasibility, roots and applicable constraints unverified.

tree_relocation.verification: Concept only; transplant feasibility, measured roots and tree constraints unverified

area_comparison.revision: P5 internal garden; equality target intentionally superseded
area_comparison.area_basis: Same230mm inward-offset isolated envelope comparison as P3; conservative fixed allowance for new glazed boundary, not measured net habitable floor area. Main wing and parking unchanged.
area_comparison.note: The lost anteroom room programme and whole-envelope comparison decrement differ because the new garden-facing boundary changes the external wall allowance and has a return around the original bay.

courtyard.note: Entire nominal courtyard zone is clear of parking. Existing front bay reduces actual usable floor area locally. Keep the gate-to-entry pedestrian corridor clear; root designer owns planting/bench layout.
courtyard.vehicle_sweeps: No sampled vehicle body enters the courtyard. N2 additional 200 mm margin reaches x0.106 near the western edge; keep hard planter/bench edges at x>=0.30.

original_front_opening_permission: P4 owner instruction permits removal of the old central front door, porch and arched landing window for a full-height attached connection. The other existing structure and the separate baseline model are retained.
footprint_audit_revision: P5 internal garden reduces enclosed link area; P4 option A parking, main wing and west-open courtyard remain unchanged
parking_option: A — northern pair on original garage forecourt
old_garage_access_tradeoff: The original garage structure and doors remain. N1/N2 use its forecourt, so vehicle access requires moving those cars. It is excluded from the six-space parking count.

pedestrian_route.proposed_paving_change: Widen threshold terrace west edge from x3.90 to x3.65; allow 1.20 m clear pedestrian strip. Route shares the unmarked private driveway with vehicle circulation.
